fields.label: Dispatch Background Jobs
fields.description: Pause publishing new work without discarding pending jobs. Already queued/running work can finish.

fields.label: Worker Queue
fields.description: Register custom queues under workers in sites/common_site_config.json, then start listening workers. Existing worker entries must be preserved. Changing queues does not move already queued work.

fields.label: Maximum In-flight Jobs
fields.description: Maximum queued plus running Flow Jobs per site (1–64). Not a provider requests/tokens-per-minute limit.

fields.label: Worker Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: RQ execution timeout (60–7200 seconds). Does not change a provider's connect/read timeout.

fields.label: Maximum Decision Attempts
fields.description: 1–10 attempts for transient decision-provider failures. Agents/triggers are never automatically retried.

fields.label: Keep Completed / Cancelled Jobs (days)
fields.description: Measured from completion, not creation. Zero disables cleanup. Pending/active/paused jobs are never removed.

fields.label: Keep Failed Jobs (days)
fields.description: Measured from terminal failure. Zero disables cleanup. Flow Run retention is independent.
